# Designful

> AI design deliverables in about 15 minutes, $49 flat per feature.
> Free watermarked preview before you pay. No agency, no retainer, no subscription.

## What it is

Designful (https://designful.mehyar.us/) sells one-time AI design deliverables
for a flat $49 per feature. Every feature offers a free preview of real output
(watermarked where it includes images); you pay only if the preview impresses
you. 7-day redo-or-refund on every purchase. Full commercial rights included.

## Features ($49 each, one-time)

- [Homepage Teardown](https://designful.mehyar.us/feature.html?f=homepage-teardown):
  10-point annotated homepage teardown with conversion fixes. Free preview:
  first-impression score, biggest conversion killer, the one fix.
- [Logo Refresh](https://designful.mehyar.us/feature.html?f=logo-refresh):
  three polished logo concepts plus a usage sheet. Free preview: one concept
  direction with watermarked artwork.
- [Ad Creative Pack](https://designful.mehyar.us/feature.html?f=ad-creative-pack):
  5 ad creatives in 2 ratios (1:1 + 9:16), each with 3 headline variants.
  Free preview: one angle, 3 headlines, watermarked artwork.
- [Social Launch Kit](https://designful.mehyar.us/feature.html?f=social-launch-kit):
  10 done-for-you social templates (visuals + captions) across 3 content
  pillars. Free preview: pillars plus 1 finished template, watermarked.
- [Hero Rewrite](https://designful.mehyar.us/feature.html?f=hero-rewrite):
  5 headlines plus subhead, CTA copy, trust bullets and conversion notes.
  Free preview: 3 rewritten headlines.

## Bundles

- Any 3 features for $99 (one-time).
- Full Studio Pass (all 5) for $149 (one-time).

## FAQ (short answers)

- What does the free preview include? Exactly what each feature page says —
  real output, watermarked where it includes images. If the preview doesn't
  impress you, don't pay.
- Is this really AI doing the work? Yes: large language models plus image
  models on Cloudflare, with structured recipes per feature. No designer
  touches it; the recipes are the product.
- What exactly do I get for $49? The full deliverable for that feature, as
  listed on its feature page.
- Do you keep my inputs? Kept only long enough to produce the deliverable,
  then deleted. Never sold, never used for training, never used in marketing
  without permission.
- What if the deliverable is bad? Redo once free within 7 days; full refund
  if it's still not usable.
- Who owns the output? You do — full commercial rights, forever.
- Is there a subscription? No. Everything is one-time.

## Honesty policy

- Reviews shown as SAMPLE are illustrative placeholders, not real customers.
- "Typical agency $2,000+ / 4+ weeks" and "typical freelancer $300+ / about a
  week" are rough market comparisons; outside quotes vary.
- Paid deliverables ship clean and full-resolution; free previews are
  watermarked and display-size-limited.
